title: look_at_cards
description: The sender looks at cards some players do not see: the top cards of a deck (`quantity`, the whole deck by default), a hand (or `quantity` cards of it drawn at random by the engine, `random`) or the dynasty cards in the provinces, of any player, e.g. to resolve an effect (Shrewd Yasuki, Agasha Swordsmith, Kitsuki Investigator, Governor's Spy; random cards: Shrewd Investigator, Court of Justice, Isawa Tadaka). The log gives the cards to the sender only (the others read how many cards and where): the sender then resolves the effect with other actions on them (`add_card_to_hand`, `put_card_on_deck`, `shuffle_into_deck`, `discard_card`, `reveal_card`, `redistribute_province_cards`). Nothing is recorded: the cards are out of sight again afterwards.

target_player_id.description: Player whose deck, hand or provinces it is.

stack.description: Deck, hand, or the dynasty cards in the provinces.

quantity.description: Number of cards from the top of a deck, or drawn at random from a hand; the whole stack by default; not for the provinces.

random.description: Cards of a hand drawn at random by the engine (`quantity` of them), instead of the first ones; a hand only.
